rv.q: Haunted by memories of a terrible event, 30-year-old illustrator Jonathan is unable to face the world beyond his flat. He summons company via dating apps: 21-year-old Wes, having come, would rather not go. Upstairs, peripatetic Claire, 29, newly arrived from the US, is out each night with a different date.
Sensitive production of Matthew López’s chamber play about urban gay life and loneliness
